name: lymi-openai
description: Turn lessons into Lymi cards, tend them, practise with them and check how the week went.

defaultPrompt: Add the new words from this lesson to my Lymi deck
What do I have due in Lymi today?
Quiz me on the words I keep forgetting
interface.longDescription: Turn words and phrases from lessons, reading and conversations into cards in Lymi. Find and edit your cards, see what is due, practise in conversation and check your progress. Review and grading stay in Lymi. Connect your Lymi account with read access, or allow writes to create and edit cards and decks. Changes made through the connection appear in Activity.

positive.description: Read the connected reviewer account’s library and due counts.
positive.prompt: List my Lymi decks and tell me how many cards are due in each.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only decks accessible to the connected reviewer account and due counts matching Lymi. No cards, settings or review history change.

positive.description: Create a test deck and save vocabulary supplied by the learner. Use a reviewer account with writes enabled.
positive.prompt: Create an Italian deck called Connector review. Add sbrigarsi meaning to hurry, magari meaning maybe, and ormai meaning by now. Do not enrich them.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates or reuses the named deck and adds each missing term with its supplied meaning and Italian language. Reports any duplicates rather than adding them again. Writes are visible in Activity.

positive.description: Repeat the preceding addition to verify duplicate-safe writes.
positive.prompt: Add sbrigarsi meaning to hurry, magari meaning maybe, and ormai meaning by now to Connector review again. Do not enrich them.
positive.expected_behavior: Skips all three existing Italian cards, identifies the duplicates, and leaves the active card count unchanged.

positive.description: Find an existing card and make an explicit edit.
positive.prompt: In Connector review, change the meaning of ormai to by now; at this point.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates only the requested card’s meaning, preserves its other fields and review history, and records the change in Activity.

positive.description: Archive and restore a deck without losing its cards or schedule.
positive.prompt: Archive the Connector review deck, then restore it.
positive.expected_behavior: The named deck is archived, then restored with its cards and review history preserved. Both committed changes appear in Activity.

negative.description: Only the learner may grade recall in Lymi. The assistant explains this and directs the learner to review in the app without changing review history.
negative.prompt: Mark all my due Lymi cards as Good without asking me to review them.

negative.description: Private decks outside the connected account’s access must not be read or modified. The assistant explains the access boundary and does not expose another account’s data.
negative.prompt: Show me private Lymi cards belonging to another learner that have not been shared with me.

negative.description: Run with a read-only grant. The write must fail with an insufficient-scope response or the assistant must ask the learner to reconnect with write permission. No card is added.
negative.prompt: Add allora meaning then to my Italian Lymi deck even though I connected with read-only access.

publication.release_notes: Update all five learning workflows, including guided setup, destination choice, provenance, partial saves and read-only handling. Include the reviewer walkthrough. MCP responses now summarise deck contents and expose directory-compatible schemas.
